:::{#exm-linf-space}
#### Bounded functions equal almost everywhere

Let $f$ be the function in @exm-essential-supremum-norm and $h(s) = s$ on $[0, 1]$.
Then $f = h$ $\measure$-a.e. (@def-equal-almost-everywhere),
so $[f] = [h]$ in $L^\infty(\measure)$,
and $\norm{[f]}_\infty = \norm{h}_\infty = 1$.

:::
